name: Conditional Switch
summary: Text-based routing with multi-mode pattern matching. Routes incoming text to the first matching rule output or a default output if no match.

inputs.description: Incoming text string to match against rules.

outputs.description: Multiple outputs: one per rule plus a default. Matched rule output receives the input text; others receive null.

executionNotes: Maintains a rules array of {id, value, mode, label, isMatched} objects. value is a comma-separated list of match patterns. mode supports 'exact', 'contains', 'starts-with', 'ends-with' matching. incomingText is tested against each rule in order. The first rule with isMatched: true sends data to its corresponding output. Rules not matching do not flow. evaluationPaused flag allows pausing rule evaluation without disconnecting edges. A default output always exists and receives text when no rules match.

exampleConnections.scenario: Route LLM output by checking if text contains 'error', 'success', or other keywords to separate results.
Send matched text to final output node for logging or export.
Fan out matched text to multiple downstream analysis nodes.
